description: Gas prices on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana, or chain=all for every chain at once: the base fee and slow, normal and fast priority fees, the latest block, and what a plain transfer and an ERC-20 transfer cost in native token and USD. EVM figures come from eth_feeHistory over the last 20 blocks; Solana from recent prioritization fees. Cached 15 seconds. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
